name: Mermaid Trip
source:
The whole football team goes to the sea during summer vacations. Suddenly Shige falls from the top of the rock to the sea. He regains consciousness at a submarine country.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
整个足球队在暑假期间来到海边。突然，繁从岩石顶端掉进了海里。当他恢复意识时，发现自己身处海底王国。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
